source_title: "A Mini Shai-Hulud Has Appeared": Bun-Based Stealer Hits SAP @cap-js and mbt npm Packages

limitation: Snyk credits StepSecurity's deobfuscation; npm registry state and SAP statements not checked by us; not a Snyk product event

availability: available to joint customers today; expanded access rolling out through 2026 (vendor)

source_title: Snyk Studio: Introducing Asynchronous, Hooks-Based Guardrails for AI Agents

source_title: TanStack Npm Packages Compromised Inside The Mini Shai Hulud Supply Chain Attack
claim_summary: Snyk reports 84 malicious artifacts across 42 @tanstack packages published 19:20-19:26 UTC by the project's legitimate release pipeline via its trusted OIDC identity after runner hijack, and calls it the first documented malicious npm package carrying valid SLSA provenance
limitation: Attribution to TeamPCP is credited to StepSecurity; the 'first documented' claim is not independently checked; TanStack's own post-mortem not read; shows provenance attestation is not proof of benign content

source_title: Mini Shai-Hulud Hits AntV: 300+ Malicious npm Packages Published via Compromised Maintainer Account
claim_summary: Snyk reports more than 300 malicious versions across 323 packages (AntV ecosystem) published in a 22-minute burst via a compromised maintainer account, representing about 16 million weekly downloads
limitation: Date conflict: RSS and byline show 2026-05-18 but text dates the burst May 19 (page metadata 2026-05-19T00:00+01:00); download figure not checked against npm; spot-check 2026-10-16: the same page's summary and wave tables give 637 malicious versions across 323 packages and an incident window of 01:39-02:06 UTC (27 minutes), which conflicts with the intro's 'more than 300' versions and '22-minute' burst; the page's datePublished (2026-05-18T23:00Z) precedes the incident it describes
